agent.f.family.buddy.title: Backup buddy
agent.f.family.buddy.sub: Back each other up with a second TitanOS
agent.f.family.buddy.intro: Two TitanOS back each other up, encrypted with the sender's key: the partner cannot read anything. The partner reaches this NAS over Tailscale.
agent.f.family.buddy.address: Address of this NAS for the partner
agent.f.family.buddy.addressHint: Tailscale name or address, e.g. nas-eva.tail1234.ts.net; a port only if it differs.
agent.f.family.buddy.volumeHint: Kept under .titanos/buddy/<partner>; each partner gets its quota.
agent.f.family.buddy.protectHint: What partners keep here is append-only: data younger than the protection period cannot be deleted, not even by the partner.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.volume: No volume for the partners' backups is mounted.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.address: The address of this NAS is not set; without it no partner can pair.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.tailscale: Tailscale is not connected; partners cannot reach this NAS right now.
agent.f.family.buddy.noJob: nothing chosen to back up yet
agent.f.family.buddy.probeNone: None yet; runs after the next backup
agent.f.family.buddy.codeHint: Enter this code on the other TitanOS (valid for 10 minutes):
agent.f.family.buddy.mine: What I back up at the partner
agent.f.family.buddy.enterHint: Or enter the code of the other TitanOS here:
agent.f.family.buddy.footer: Backups are made with restic and a password only this NAS knows. At the partner everything is append-only; nothing younger than {days} days is deleted.
agent.f.family.buddy.endText: The schedule to {name} ends and {name} can no longer store anything here. What this NAS backed up at {name} stays there until {name} deletes it.
agent.f.family.buddy.endData: Also delete the backups of {name} on this NAS
agent.f.family.catalog.title: Skill catalog
agent.f.family.catalog.intro: The catalog is a signed list of skills. None is set by default: the owner decides the address and the public key.
agent.f.family.catalog.keyHint: The signature lies next to the catalog at the same address with ".sig". Without a valid signature nothing is shown and nothing installed.
agent.f.family.catalog.lead: Skills of other TitanOS users. Only what is validly signed is installed; you see the content first.
agent.f.family.catalog.unknown: This account does not have these tools: {tools}. It cannot be installed.
agent.f.family.catalog.secret: The skill contains something that looks like a password or key; it cannot be installed.
agent.f.family.catalog.askHint: The skill itself changes nothing. Tools that change something ask first as always.
agent.f.family.catalog.shareHint: Downloads a skill as a package to submit. Submitting is done with whoever runs the catalog.
agent.f.family.diary.title: Family diary
agent.f.family.diary.sub: "What did we do at the weekend?"
agent.f.family.diary.intro: The agent answers in the chat what happened on a day or weekend, only from sources with your own rights. The sources are named under the answer.
agent.f.family.diary.srcHint.chats: What you talked about with the agent that day.
agent.f.family.diary.srcHint.home: Logbook of released devices; owners and administrators only.
agent.f.family.diary.srcHint.photos: When the photos of an own folder were taken; a sleeping disk is not woken in the background.
agent.f.family.diary.srcHint.immich: Through the Immich API with your key.
agent.f.family.diary.srcHint.frigate: Camera events, also "Who was at the door?".
agent.f.family.diary.frigateHint: "Who was at the door?" works only with Frigate.
agent.f.family.buddy.jobError: Paired, but the backup job could not be saved: {error}
